meta.title: Download
meta.description: Download Persisty for macOS, Windows or Linux, and see every version with its date, size and SHA-256.

title: Download Persisty
body: The latest version for each system. On the Mac the app is signed and notarised by Apple; on Windows and Linux it ships as a preview.
bodyNone: There is no version to download yet. Pick your system and get an e-mail when it ships.

mac.name: macOS
mac.note: Where Persisty is used every day. Tested on Apple Silicon; Intel should work.
mac.released: Signed and notarised by Apple. Tested on Apple Silicon; Intel should work.

windows.name: Windows
windows.note: Ships as a preview: the build exists but has not been tested on real machines yet.
windows.released: Unsigned and not yet tested on real machines. If SmartScreen warns you, click More info › Run anyway.

linux.name: Linux
linux.note: Ships as a preview, on the same terms as Windows.
linux.released: Unsigned and not yet tested on real machines. Before opening the AppImage, make it executable with chmod +x {name}.

items.title: Nothing but the app
items.body: Everything Persisty needs ships inside the app. No other dependency to install.

items.title: Claude Code, if you use agents
items.body: For agent sessions with states, resume and several accounts. Plain terminals work without it.

items.title: Git, for the git features
items.body: Changes, branches, restore points and a folder per session use the git on your machine.

account.title: Want to hear about new versions?
account.body: Create an account with your e-mail and get a note when a new version is out. You sign in with a code, no password.

meta.title: All versions
meta.description: Every Persisty version to download, with the date, size and SHA-256 of each file.

versions.title: All versions
versions.body: Every version of Persisty, newest first, with the size and SHA-256 of each file.
versions.verify: To check a download, compare its SHA-256 with what shasum -a 256 file-name shows on Mac and Linux, or Get-FileHash file-name in Windows PowerShell.
